desc: Burgers, sandwiches & other American bites, plus desserts, in chill surrounds with a modern vibe.
addr: XJC2+M9M, 22, St Mark's Rd, Shanthala Nagar, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001, India

rev.t: I recently visited this restaurant with a group of five friends for dinner, and we were pleasantly surprised by the exceptional service. Ordering was effortless, and the staff confirmed our order before preparing it, which was a nice touch. …
This place really surprised me with their veg menu. I went with my friends and most of us decided to try veg—it was totally worth it. …
Good food and a nice menu with plenty of options. The Mushroom Taco Bao was the standout dish—crispy, flavorful, and something a little different from the usual. Definitely worth a try!!
